channel.title: Mike's Stimpsons Latest Work
channel.description: The most recent photographs and designs I've been working on.

item.title: From the End of Time
item.description: So, I see LEGO made some D&D minifigs! I admit I've not been keeping up with LEGO releases for the past few years, but these last weeks I did have the urge to start taking some photographs again so I did a bit of revision.

item.title: Big Telly
item.description: The concept of the "Big Telly" may only be familiar to those of a certain age.

item.title: Entrance
item.description: I've just finished a rewatch of the Andor TV series - I always manage to find inspiration for something by sitting myself in front of some good Star Wars for a few hours.
